description: Implementation of the RepositoryDependant class managing Git repository interactions, including commit retrieval, remote access, and repository management.

classes.name: RepositoryDependant
classes.description: Class providing methods to interact with Git repositories, including commit and remote management, and repository lifecycle handling.

methods.name: RepositoryDependant
methods.description: Constructor initializing repository path and setting up the repository object.

methods.name: ~RepositoryDependant
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up repository instance and managing singleton map.

methods.name: getHeadLibGitCommit
methods.description: Retrieves the latest commit (HEAD) from the repository.

methods.name: getLibGitCommitSha
methods.description: Converts a git commit object to its SHA string.

methods.name: shaToLibGitOid
methods.description: Converts SHA string to git_oid object.

methods.name: getLibGitCommit
methods.description: Retrieves a commit object from its SHA string.

methods.name: libGitOidToSha
methods.description: Converts a git_oid to its SHA string representation.

methods.name: getLibGitRemote
methods.description: Retrieves a remote by name from the repository.

methods.name: getParentShas
methods.description: Gets SHA strings of parent commits for a given commit.

methods.name: getLibGitTreeForCommit
methods.description: Retrieves the tree object for a specific commit.

methods.name: setLibGitRepository
methods.description: Initializes or reuses a git repository object based on the path.

methods.name: openRepository
methods.description: Opens a git repository at the specified path, ensuring it exists and is not bare.
